metadata.title: Marmaris, 2022 — Historical fire reconstruction
metadata.disclaimer: Decision-support prototype. Not an evacuation order; follow official instructions.

forecast_updates.note: Forecast updates are re-initialised from the union of VIIRS and Sentinel-2 observations so far, computed by tools/build_marmaris_scenario.py with the fire repository's model on its reconstruction grid (forecasts end at that grid's edge).
